fusions.name: Fastened Lunge
fusions.desc: Rushes you to an enemy up to 5 tiles away, then deals 12 blunt damage, leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and holds it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Helping Hoof
fusions.desc: Stamps the ground and deals 26 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles. On a hit, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Soothing Touch
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 8 seconds. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Follow Through
fusions.desc: When you strike with your weapon, your next strike gains 30% critical hit chance. Once every 10 seconds. You gain 5% dodge chance.
